notes.title: Chill Update - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

A few pesky bugs snuck into yesterday’s update so here’s a quick hotfix to set things right.

Scares are ACTUALLY off this time. For real for real.
If you turned off scares and still got scared… sorry... That’s fixed now. Or is it?.... Kidding!.... Or am I? 

Monster stuck
Rare occasion when the monster stayed in places after turning it on again is also fixed!

Flashlight jerk 
No more flashlight jerk happening when entering the office

Pause scrolling
Scrolling should not switch items when paused

Flashlight & boxes
When the box is dropped the flashlight should not switch anymore

Achievement cheese removed
Some achievements are not cheesable anymore by going to the main menu and back

Hope you have fun chillin' and packin'!

Cybernetic Walrus

notes.title: The "Chill Update" is available now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The team has been hard at work on the latest update for Order 13. This includes achievements, new cats, and some game options. Let's just get straight into it.

Chill Mode & Options
You guys asked for it, chill mode is here! Head to Options, scroll down in the General tab, where you can toggle various options. 

There are 3 options you can turn on or off (we generally recommend you have all of these OFF if this is your first time playing the game).
[olist]
 Disable Monster - This stops the monster from appearing in the warehouse
 Disable Cat Happiness - This stops the Cat Meter from going down when you are outside the room
 Disable Scares - This stops jump scares from happening in-game
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/b6bdbdbd48ba5880fbe6c5f8dfcb10ed78b04f48.jpg

Randomized orders
Based on community request, we also added randomized orders. Please note this will only happen AFTER a certain *cough* part of the game.[spoiler]Click on [Continue] at the end screen to keep playing [/spoiler], you will now get random orders across different locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/3966ca164dab49f4fb60cd3a79687fb5e701d118.png

More cat skins & accessories
15 new cat skins have been added including the very special "cat" skin. Originally intended as an April Fool's joke, we mistakenly placed a 500-like bet and... lost. The special one unlocks after you obtain the "W Game" Achievement.

New hats and cosmetics! Yes, we added batcat. Airplane ears activated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/494a3bc836b9b1c3a73b6d198800b95376d48634.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/ca9855a2ca4e648109df4946656bcbb81354cd0f.jpg

Become Employee of the Month! Trophies now available
You bought everything but still wanna go for more? We added some decorative trophies. Let us know how many days it took you to unlock everything. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/99b3d325cff04d45e1aed707fb8c237422ddca29.png

Achievements
The more the merrier, so we added 33. Happy hunting!

New languages
Added Turkish, Polish, Thai, Spanish, Traditional Chinese

Improvements

 Mouse Invert - you can now invert the mouse
 Scare timings - Based on your feedback we tweaked the timing of scares
 Item icons - Instead of a white box, we added nice icons for the items in the backpack UI!
 Adjusted economy - tweaked the economy to make it more balanced

Bugfixes 

 Basement monster lingering sound fixed. You should no longer hear monster noises after they despawned
 Special characters should use the correct fonts
 Cat picture doesn't beep anymore when you point it at ticket and click
 Exit pad is now localized
 UI layout fixes to make text fit better
 Tape printer and Sticker Printer now have separate names
 Ambience audio no longer stays active after force exiting a warehouse area (either by dying or going to the main menu)
 Tweaked the safe zones in the basements, the monster should not catch you when you are crouching under the exit points
 Added extra loading screen at the start of the game to help with crashes at startup

Will we keep adding content the game?
Not sure. We're pretty happy with how the game works, and people seem to be enjoying it. In an age where games are constantly updated post-release (whether to fix a broken release, adding content, or tweaking values), we're not sure this makes sense for us. Obviously if bugs are found we will try our best to address them, but we're really looking forward to making new stuff that you can play! Anyway, would love to know what you all think about this topic.


The April Fools post we made a couple of weeks ago for those who missed it...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/712dda30f1b923c896f20b33825355a198ab7ddd.jpg

Enjoy the update and see you around!
Cybernetic Walrus

notes.title: New Companion In The Next Update! (updated post)🐾
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We want to use this opportunity to once again thank each and every one of you to pick up a copy of Order 13! The team is currently working on the next update scheduled for later this month. 

In this new update, players will have the option to swap the cat for the monster as their emotional support companion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/bed4abff7307e77e19ee68ee9568549241f03be6.png

Yes, you heard that right — why settle for purrs when you can have guttural growls and the comforting sound of heavy breathing behind you while packing orders?

Features of the Monster Companion:
 
Emits low-frequency growls that scare away cats.
Automatically feeds itself. You might be missing a limb when waking up.
Occasionally disappears to hunt in the warehouse.
Sheds slime, which makes the floor slippery.


We hope you will have fun with your new pet soon enough!

Happy April Fools! 

Jokes aside... If this announcement reaches 500 likes, we'll do it!

EDIT: we woke up to 630 likes. OK!!!! Fine. You win! 

EDIT 2.0: Fine! The team is working on it. Is this what you want? You sick .... Just kidding, we love our community. Can we get to a 1000 likes for no reason?

EDIT 3.0: 1000 likes!! W community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413925/2529d11740430ef8544b470bfd691eaeb54587e8.png

Sincerely,

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Fixes for crashes, graphical issues
notes.notes:
Fellow Jolly Box Co. workers!

We have released a patch that contains possible fixes for the most common issues that came up during the release of the game such as:


 Crash after the splash screen
For this one, we made some improvements but please bear with the game! Even if Windows says it crashed, click on "Wait for the program to respond" and give it a second! We will improve this in a future patch further!

 Crash after entering the warehouse
For a lot of you switching to Dx11 fixed this. Now the game is running on Dx11 by default so should be good to go from the start!

 Graphical glitches, black bars, weird stuff
Same as the previous one. Dx11 should fix this!

 Disappearing objects
This one was a tough one to track down. It seems that it also was because of Dx12. But still, even with Dx 11, it was an issue for some mostly on laptops with integrated GPUs. We do not officially support integrated GPUs as they are below the minimum system requirements. But...

IMPORTANT: If you have disappearing objects after this patch, please switch to the public_test Beta Participation branch on Steam. Right-click on the Game -> Properties -> Betas -> Select public_test from the drop-down

DISCLAIMER: Switching to public_test will make the performance worse, but it could possibly fix the disappearing objects issue.



Other than that, we fixed some minor UI and sound issues.

Thank you again for playing ORDER 13! It means the world to us. Come hang out with us on Discord!

notes.title: 🚨 Order 13 Demo Update – Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey warehouse workers & cat lovers! 

We've got a fresh Order 13 demo update ready for you—packed with new features, improvements, and of course, more cat content!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489660/ORDER_13_Demo/

What's New in the Demo?

✅ An Extra Workday – More time to fulfill orders, pay off your debt, and endure the horrors of the warehouse.
🐱 Cat Customization – Give your feline friend a unique name and choose from different visual styles.
🧸 More Cat Toys – Treat your floofy companion to new toys from the shop.
🎵 New Office Music – Fresh tunes to keep your workspace cozy and calm.
🔊 New Sounds – More immersive audio, whether it's footsteps, eerie whispers, or the rustling of something... unseen.
🛠️ Bug Fixes (& Probably New Bugs) – The warehouse is haunted, and so is our code. Let us know what you find!
📋 Easier First Day – Adjustments to make the start of your warehouse journey smoother.
🖼️ More Instructional Posters – Learn the ropes while keeping an eye out for... oddities.
💾 Progress is saved – At the beginning of the day, your current money and unlocks are saved. If you fail a day, you don't have to restart from day 1.

The updated demo is live now—give it a try!

Enjoying Order 13? Help us by adding the game to your wishlist—it makes a huge difference and ensures you won’t miss future updates! 

Enjoy! 
Cybernetic Walrus
